name: Fiscal Intercessor
subtitle: blessed be the moolah
rules: PLEAD -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If damage is inflicted to the character this turn, reduce the amount by 1.
flavor: "May this moolah begat more moolah, and may that moolah also be ours. Let us give thanks for all that we have and all we shall take, and deliver our moolah from the taking of others."
notes: Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Underpaid Ancestor
subtitle: always pay your departed dearly
rules: If this card is put into your discard pile from play, you may pay 3. If you do, put it into play under your control. Deplete it.
flavor: "I wants my gold and rubies! I wants my crystal and pearls! Damn you, greedy children! I'll take you all instead!"
notes: Card prints 'If this card is put into your discard pile'; catalog has 'When this card is put'. Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Chancellor of Reinstatement
subtitle: repurposes the purposeless
rules: REINSTATE -- COST – Pay 4. Destroy this card. Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into play under your control if it has numeric cost X or less, where X is the number of [G] you control.
flavor: "You! You're a baker now. And you... a phlebotomist."
notes: Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Because God Said So!
subtitle: thou shalt cast out yon lepers
rules: COST – Pick a blocking character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 5 strength and 5 life.
flavor: Thou shalt stone not once but thrice in the head those who blaspheme against god, and mash yon girly men with ye giant masher, and rend unto fire those unloved by the children of god, yea, and death unto fat chicks.
notes: Card prints 'COST –'; catalog has 'EXTRA COST:' (newer templating). Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.

name: Theocratic Senate of Marduun
subtitle: protecting your right to do what we say
rules: UNIQUE THEOCRATIC SENATE OF MARDUUN -- Your opponent cannot attack your faction. -- If a character inflicts damage to this card, inflict the same amount of damage to the character.
flavor: Terrifying machine of state, as finite as it is deterministic.
notes: Card prints 'Your opponent cannot attack' and 'If a character inflicts'; catalog has 'Your opponents' and 'When a character'. Footer shows www.thespoils.com and no artist credit.
